summary.text: Frank Steele is the Republican candidate for Arizona State Senate District 24 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Analise Ortiz.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as an Arizona native, U.S. Army veteran, small-business owner, cybersecurity executive and CPA.

paragraphs.text: Frank Steele served in the U.S. Army Reserve from 1987 to 2002 and earned a graduate degree from Arizona State University.
His career experience includes working as a business executive.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he and his wife own a small residential memory-care home serving seniors in the West Valley.

Steele said his priorities include keeping taxes low, reducing unnecessary government costs and regulation, protecting seniors on fixed incomes from being taxed out of their homes, supporting law enforcement and first responders, and supporting school choice while strengthening public schools.
